prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1134; do not mention it.)
text: This firm represents the individual injured in the motor vehicle collision described in the claim you have opened under the reference number on file. Our client was struck on the driver's side when the at-fault vehicle entered the intersection against the signal, and our client has sustained injuries that are currently under medical evaluation. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, in person, by telephone, or in writing. We ask that you provide, within the time permitted under applicable regulations, a complete statement of all liability coverage available under the policy held by your insured, including the bodily injury limits per person and per occurrence, and confirmation of any excess or umbrella coverage. We further request that you preserve all evidence relating to this loss, including vehicle data, photographs, dash camera footage, recorded statements, claim file materials, and any telematics or event data recorder information, and that you suspend any routine destruction of such materials.
